verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a first-party, Shadcn-style component set (Proa UI) that is vendored into your repo via `proa ui add`. It does not show any third-party pre-built UI component libraries or an ecosystem of them. A first-party library is an adjacent feature, not the third-party ecosystem the story asks about, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pick from a rich ecosystem of third-party pre-built UI component libraries for the framework

citations.quote: Proa UI offers Shadcn style Proa components. Source in your repo, in typed Rust.
`proa ui add button` vendors the source into `src/components/` where you own and edit it like any other file
